# ADR Kit

> ADR Kit is a command-line tool for Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
> It turns architecture decisions into plain Markdown files with a
> machine-checkable lifecycle: proposed → accepted / rejected / superseded.
> Built for humans and AI coding assistants.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/adr-kit
- CLI reference: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit/blob/main/docs/cli.md
- Record format: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit/blob/main/docs/record-format.md
- Workflow guide: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit/blob/main/docs/workflow.md
- Changelog: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

## Quick start

Requires Node.js 20.19 or later.

```bash
npm install -g adr-kit
cd your-project
adrkit init --tools claude
adrkit propose "Use SQLite for session storage"
adrkit validate
adrkit accept "Use SQLite for session storage"
```

## Key facts

- Records are plain Markdown; the parser and validator are the format
  contract.
- Validation failures are success signals: fresh drafts fail until every
  required section is filled in.
- Proposals carry dates; decision numbers are assigned only at accept time.
- AI tool integrations (`adrkit init --tools`): claude, codex, cursor,
  github-copilot, agents (generic .agents/). Installs agent skills and
  slash-command files.
- Works alongside spec-driven tools like OpenSpec: OpenSpec tracks what is
  being built; ADR Kit records why a direction was chosen.
- License: MIT. Single runtime dependency: yaml.
